parts.content: What was the female labour force participation rate (LFPR) for women aged 15 years and above, all-India, rural+urban, by usual status (ps+ss), in PLFS 2023-24, in per cent?

instructions: You answer questions about public data using only the tools of the connected data server. Look the answer up; never answer from memory. Report figures exactly as the data gives them and cite where they came from. If the tools can't answer it, set found to false.

parts.args: {"dataset": "PLFS", "frequency_code": 1, "user_query": "What was the female labour force participation rate (LFPR) for women aged 15 years and above, all-India, rural+urban, by usual status (ps+ss), in PLFS 2023-24, in per cent?"}

frequency_code_1_Annual.description: LFPR (Labour Force Participation Rate, in per cent)
frequency_code_1_Annual.definition:
The Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) is defined as the percentage of persons in the labour force among the persons in the population. LFPR for persons based on usual status (ps+ss) and current weekly status for each State/UT has been obtained. The workforce in the usual status (ps+ss) is obtained by considering the usual principal status and the subsidiary status together. The workforce in the usual status (ps+ss) includes (a) the persons who worked for a relatively long part of the 365 days preceding the date of survey and (b) the persons from among the remaining population who had worked at least for 30 days during the reference period of 365 days preceding the date of survey.
This measured in current weekly status (CWS) gives the average picture of the workforce in a short period of one week during the survey period. The estimate of workforce in the current weekly status is derived considering those who worked for at least 1 hour on any day during the 7 days preceding the date of survey. Data is available for various age groups that is 15-29 years, 15 years and above & all ages for different Gender that includues male, female & person. 
LFPR data presented among persons belonging to different social groups (viz., scheduled tribe, scheduled caste, other backward class and the rest referred to as others) and for major religious groups (Hinduism, Islam, Christianity and Sikhism) are presented.
The percentage of workers in usual status (ps+ss) having particular levels of education among persons with that level of education is defined as the education level not literate, literate & upto primary, middle, secondary, higher secondary, diploma/certificate course, graduate, post graduate & above, secondary & above, all

frequency_code_1_Annual.description: Average wage/salary earnings (Rs. 0.00) during the preceding calendar month from regular wage/salaried employment
frequency_code_1_Annual.definition:
Average wage/salary earnings during the preceding calendar month from the regular wage/salaried employment among the regular wage/
salaried employees in CWS for each State/ UT.  Data is available for Gender that includues male, female & person. Also available for sector that are rural, urban and rural+urban. In PLFS, information on earnings from employment was collected for all three categories of workers, viz., self-employed persons, regular wage/salaried employees and casual labour.

frequency_code_1_Annual.description: Average wage earnings (Rs. 0.00) per day from casual labour work other than public works
frequency_code_1_Annual.definition: In PLFS, wage earnings by casual labour were recorded for each of the days of the reference week (last 7 days preceding the date of the survey) when the household member had worked as casual labour for all State/UTs. The average wage earnings per day by casual labour engaged in works other than public works during the survey period. Data is available for Gender that includues male, female & person. Also available for sector that are rural, urban and rural+urban.

frequency_code_1_Annual.description: Average gross earnings (Rs. 0.00) during last 30 days from self-employment
frequency_code_1_Annual.definition:
In PLFS, information on gross earnings from self-employment work was collected through a single-shot question from the self-employed persons in current weekly status.  It may be noted that average gross earnings have been calculated by excluding those self-employed
persons who had reported earning as zero/not reported cases. Average gross earnings during last 30 days from
self-employment among self-employed persons in CWS for each State/ UT are presented. Data is available for Gender that includues male, female & person. Also available for sector that are rural, urban and rural+urban

content._note: frequency_code=1 (Annual) has 8 indicators including all wages. It also has quarterly breakdowns (quarter_code 2-5) for indicator_codes 6-8 in Agriculture Years (YYYY-YY).frequency_code=2 (Quarterly) has 4 indicators for quarterly bulletin tables. frequency_code=3 (Monthly) has 3 indicators (2025+ data only). Annual calendar years are stored as 'PLFS YYYY' (e.g. 'PLFS 2024'); plain '2024' is also accepted by get_data. Annual indicator_code=4 also has industry_code and nic_division_code breakdowns (calendar years, All India only). Pick the frequency_code whose indicator set matches the query.
content.next_step: get_metadata(dataset, indicator_code) to retrieve valid filter values.
content.related_datasets: Datasets with overlapping coverage: IIP (production index, growth rates) vs ASI (factory financials: capital, wages, GVA). IIP (industrial production) vs ISP (services production). CPI (consumer inflation) vs WPI (wholesale inflation).

instructions: You answer questions about public data using only the tools of the connected data server. Look the answer up; never answer from memory. Report figures exactly as the data gives them and cite where they came from. If the tools can't answer it, set found to false.

parts.args: {"dataset": "PLFS", "frequency_code": 1, "indicator_code": 1, "user_query": "What was the female labour force participation rate (LFPR) for women aged 15 years and above, all-India, rural+urban, by usual status (ps+ss), in PLFS 2023-24, in per cent?"}

api_params.name: indicator_code
api_params.description: Indicator code. SINGLE VALUE ONLY — comma-separated causes 500 error for all frequency codes. frequency_code=1 (Annual): 1=LFPR, 2=WPR, 3=UR, 4=Percentage distribution of workers, 5=Employment conditions of regular wage/salaried employees, 6=Average salaried wage/salary earnings (₹/month), 7=Average casual labour wage earnings (₹/day), 8=Average self-employment gross earnings (₹/month). frequency_code=2 (Quarterly bulletin): 1=LFPR, 2=WPR, 3=UR, 4=Percentage distribution of workers only (codes 5-8 not available). frequency_code=3 (Monthly): 1=LFPR, 2=WPR, 3=UR only (codes 4-8 not available). Annual calendar years ("PLFS YYYY") store each breakdown as a separate table, so pass only one breakdown filter at a time: indicator_code=4 - one of broad_industry_work, broad_status_employment, employee_contract, enterprise_type, industry_section, nco_division, nic_division (exception: industry_code together with broad_status_employment_code); indicator_codes 1-3 - age_code alone, education_code alone, or age_code with religion_code or with social_category_code. Annual Agriculture Years ("YYYY-YY") store all breakdowns together, so they can be combined.

api_params.name: frequency_code
api_params.description: Controls which indicator SET is available — not just time granularity. 1 = Annual (indicators 1-8; Agriculture Years 2017-18 to 2023-24 with year_type_code=1, calendar years "PLFS 2022" to "PLFS 2025" with year_type_code=2; indicator_code=5 has Agriculture Years only). 2 = Quarterly bulletin (indicators 1-4 only), calendar years 2018 to 2026, plain YYYY format. Some quarters are not available. 3 = Monthly (indicators 1-3 only, data from 2025 onwards, plain calendar year format). Use frequency_code=3 for latest/recent data. Use frequency_code=2 only when user explicitly asks for quarterly bulletin.

api_params.name: year
api_params.description: Year filter. Format depends on frequency_code: frequency_code=1 (Annual): Agriculture Year YYYY-YY (year_type_code=1, e.g. "2023-24", data 2017-18 to 2023-24) or calendar year "PLFS YYYY" (year_type_code=2, data "PLFS 2022" to "PLFS 2025"). Plain "2024" is also accepted: the server sends it as "PLFS 2024". frequency_code=2 (Quarterly): plain calendar year, e.g. "2024" (not the YYYY-YY Agriculture Year format). Data: 2018 to 2026. frequency_code=3 (Monthly): plain calendar year YYYY (e.g. "2025", "2026"). Do NOT use YYYY-YY for monthly. Comma-separated for multiple values. If year is omitted, the server uses the latest available year that has data for the given filters (returned as year_auto_selected). Pass year="all" to get every year (for trends / time series).

api_params.name: month_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=3 (Monthly). Do NOT pass for Annual or Quarterly bulletin. 1-12 (Jan-Dec). Monthly data currently covers Apr-Dec 2025 and Jan-Feb, Apr-Sep 2026 (March 2026 / month_code=3 has no data). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: state_code
api_params.description: State code. Valid codes: 1-38 (individual states/UTs) and 99 (All India aggregate). Use state_code=99 for All India. Omitting state_code returns ALL states (many more records). Note: Quarterly (frequency_code=2): 22 states plus 99 (All India). Monthly (frequency_code=3): only 99 (All India). For the exact list, call get_metadata with the same frequency_code and indicator_code.

api_params.name: gender_code
api_params.description: 1=Male, 2=Female, 3=Person (all genders combined). Default to 3 unless user asks for gender breakdown. Available for all frequency codes. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: age_code
api_params.description: Age group code. frequency_code=1 (Annual): 1=15 years and above, 2=15-29 years, 3=15-59 years, 4=all. Age breakdown is for indicator_codes 1-3 only; annual indicator_codes 4-8 have only 4 (all) in Agriculture Years and no age_code in calendar years. frequency_code=2 and 3: 1=15 years and above, 2=15-29 years, 4=all. Code 3 (15-59) not available. For quarterly indicator_code=4, only code 1 is available. Default to 4 (all) unless user asks for age breakdown. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: sector_code
api_params.description: 1=Rural, 2=Urban, 3=Rural+Urban combined. Default to 3 unless user asks for rural/urban breakdown. Available for all frequency codes, but frequency_code=2 (Quarterly) years 2018-2024 have Urban (2) only; Rural (1) and Rural+Urban (3) quarterly data start in 2025. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: quarter_code
api_params.description: Quarter filter. Actual codes: 1=all, 2=JUL-SEP, 3=OCT-DEC, 4=JAN-MAR, 5=APR-JUN. For frequency_code=1 (Annual): quarters 2-5 exist only for indicator_codes 6, 7, 8 in Agriculture Years (YYYY-YY). Indicators 1-5 have only 1 (all) in Agriculture Years. Calendar years ("PLFS YYYY") have no quarter_code, so do not pass it for them. For frequency_code=2 (Quarterly bulletin): use to filter by specific quarter. Do NOT use for frequency_code=3 (Monthly) — use month_code instead. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: year_type_code
api_params.description: Year type classification. 1=Agriculture Year (YYYY-YY), 2=Calendar Year ("PLFS YYYY"). Applies to annual data. Quarterly rows have no year_type_code (NULL); monthly rows are mostly 2 or NULL. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: weekly_status_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual). Not available for Quarterly bulletin or Monthly. 1=PS+SS (principal + subsidiary status), 2=CWS (current weekly status). indicator_codes 1-4 have both; indicator_code=5 has only 1 (PS+SS); indicator_codes 6-8 have only 2 (CWS). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: religion_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual). Not available for Quarterly bulletin or Monthly. 1=All, 2=Hinduism, 3=Islam, 4=Christianity, 5=Sikhism. Breakdown is for indicator_codes 1-3 only (indicator_codes 4-8 have only 1=All in Agriculture Years and none in calendar years). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: social_category_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual). Not available for Quarterly bulletin or Monthly. 1=All, 2=Scheduled Tribe, 3=Scheduled Caste, 4=Other Backward Class, 5=Others. Breakdown is for indicator_codes 1-3 only (indicator_codes 4-8 have only 1=All in Agriculture Years and none in calendar years). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: education_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual). Not available for Quarterly bulletin or Monthly. 1=Not literate, 2=Literate & upto primary, 3=Middle, 4=Secondary, 5=Higher secondary, 6=Diploma/certificate, 7=Graduate, 8=Post graduate & above, 9=Secondary & above, 0=All. Breakdown is for indicator_codes 1-3 only (indicator_codes 4-8 have only 0=All in Agriculture Years and none in calendar years). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: broad_industry_work_code
api_params.description: Applicable when frequency_code=1 or 2 AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers). Returns empty for any other indicator_code or frequency. Codes 1-4. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: broad_status_employment_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers). Returns empty for any other indicator_code or frequency. Codes 1-6. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: employee_contract_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual). Codes 1-4: indicator_code=5 (Employment conditions of regular wage/salaried employees, Agriculture Years) and indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers, calendar years "PLFS YYYY" only). Code 5=all is used in other Agriculture-Year rows. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: enterprise_size_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers), Agriculture Years (YYYY-YY) only. Returns empty for any other indicator_code or frequency, and for calendar years. Codes 1-6. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: enterprise_type_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers). Returns empty for any other indicator_code or frequency. Codes 1-9. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: industry_section_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers). Returns empty for any other indicator_code or frequency. Codes 1-22 (calendar years "PLFS YYYY": 1-21). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: nco_division_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers). Returns empty for any other indicator_code or frequency. Agriculture Years (YYYY-YY): codes 1-11 (1=all, 2-11=NCO Division 1-9 and X). Calendar years ("PLFS YYYY"): codes 12-188 (sub-divisions, 3-digit NCO codes, divisions, 188=total). Codes other than 1 are All India (state_code=99) only. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: nic_group_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1(Annual) or 2(Quarterly) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers). Codes 1-14 (annual: Agriculture Years only, not calendar years; quarterly: only 1, 4, 9, 14). indicator_code=5 is stored with code 2 (industry: 05-99). Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: industry_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers), calendar years only (year="PLFS 2022".."PLFS 2025", year_type_code=2), All India (state_code=99) only. Used together with broad_status_employment_code. Codes 1-13: 1=01-03 (agriculture), 2=05-09 (mining & quarrying), 3=05-43 (secondary), 4=10-33 (manufacturing), 5=35-39 (electricity and water supply), 6=41-43 (construction), 7=45-47 (trade), 8=45-99 (tertiary), 9=49-53 (transport), 10 =55-56 (accommodation & food services), 12=58-99 (other services), 13=total. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: nic_division_code
api_params.description: Only for frequency_code=1 (Annual) AND indicator_code=4 (Percentage distribution of workers), calendar years only ("PLFS 2022".."PLFS 2025"), All India (state_code=99) only. Codes 1-758 map to the NIC codes in the nic_division table (e.g. 1=0111, 2=0112), and 758=total. Call get_metadata for the code-to-NIC mapping. Comma-separated for multiple values.

api_params.name: limit
api_params.description: Records per page (default 10). IMPORTANT: 10 is too low for most queries. Use 50+ for monthly data (11 records/indicator), 100+ for quarterly/annual with breakdowns. Annual indicator_code=4 can have 1000+ records across all breakdown dimensions.

api_params.name: page
api_params.description: Enter the page no. (from 1 to n.)

api_params.name: Format
api_params.description: Select the Output format

content.parameter_notes: frequency_code selects the indicator set, not time granularity. indicator_code accepts a single integer only; comma-separated values cause a 500 error. frequency_code=1 (Annual: Agriculture Years 2017-18 to 2023-24 with year_type_code=1, calendar years 'PLFS 2022' to 'PLFS 2025' with year_type_code=2; indicator_code=5 has Agriculture Years only): indicators 1=LFPR, 2=WPR, 3=UR, 4=Worker distribution, 5=Employment conditions, 6=Salaried wages, 7=Casual wages, 8=Self-employment earnings. Year format: YYYY-YY (e.g. 2023-24) for Agriculture Years (year_type_code=1); for calendar years pass YYYY or 'PLFS YYYY' - both work, the server converts to 'PLFS YYYY'. frequency_code=2 (Quarterly bulletin, calendar years 2018 to 2026): indicators 1-4 only. Quarterly 2018-2024 is Urban only (sector_code=2); Rural (1) and Rural+Urban (3) start in 2025. Year format: plain YYYY (e.g. 2024). quarter_code: 2=JUL-SEP, 3=OCT-DEC, 4=JAN-MAR, 5=APR-JUN (annual: quarter_code 2-5 only for indicator_codes 6-8 in Agriculture Years; 1=all otherwise). Available quarters: 2018 [2,3,5], 2019-2024 [2,3,4,5], 2025 [2,3,5], 2026 [4,5]. frequency_code=3 (Monthly, Apr 2025 to Sep 2026 except March 2026 - month_code=3 has no data, All India only): indicators 1-3 only. Year format: YYYY (e.g. 2025). year_type_code: 1=Agriculture Year (YYYY-YY), 2=Calendar Year ('PLFS YYYY'); applies to annual data (NULL for quarterly rows). state_code=99 for All India; omitting state_code returns all states. indicator_code=4 annual calendar years also support industry_code (1-13, used with broad_status_employment_code) and nic_division_code (1-758); both All India (state_code=99) only. nco_division_code: Agriculture Years codes 1-11, calendar years codes 12-188; codes other than 1 are All India only. In calendar years each breakdown is a separate table, so pass only one breakdown filter at a time (indicator_code=4: industry_code may be combined with broad_status_employment_code; indicator_codes 1-3: age_code alone, education_code alone, or age_code with religion_code or social_category_code). If year is omitted, get_data uses the latest available year that has data for the given filters (reported as year_auto_selected); pass year='all' for every year (trend/time-series questions).
